---
title: "8 Priming and Loading the Flongle"
---

**Approximate time:** < 1 hour

## Materials

- MinION device and Flongle adapter
- Flongle Flow Cell (the WAMBAnet reference used FLO-FLG114)
- Sequencing Buffer (SB)
- Library Beads (LIB)
- Flow Cell Tether (FCT)
- Flow Cell Flush (FCF)
- Prepared DNA library
- 1.5 mL tube, 200 µL tips, filter tips

::: {.callout-important}
Oxford Nanopore kit formulations and loading instructions can change. Verify kit and flow-cell identifiers against the material actually supplied for the workshop before using volumes from an older handout.
:::

## Reference workflow

- [ ] Thaw SB, LIB, FCT and FCF at room temperature.
- [ ] Mix as required by the current kit instructions; briefly spin down and place on ice where instructed.
- [ ] WAMBAnet reference priming mix: 117 µL FCF + 3 µL FCT.
- [ ] Insert the Flongle adapter into the powered MinION before inserting the flow cell.
- [ ] Insert the Flongle flow cell securely.
- [ ] Open the sample port without touching the flow-cell array or adapter contacts.
- [ ] Prime carefully, avoiding air gaps and forceful dispensing.
- [ ] WAMBAnet reference sequencing mix: 15 µL SB + 10 µL freshly mixed LIB + 5 µL DNA library.
- [ ] Load without introducing air bubbles.
- [ ] Seal the flow cell as specified by the current device instructions.
- [ ] Close the device lid and proceed to MinKNOW.
